input: Set a screen time limit on my phone

gold.taskTitle: Set a screen time limit on my phone
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to configure screen time restrictions on their phone to manage and limit their device usage.

questions.title: What phone operating system are you using, iOS or Android?
questions.description: Identify the phone platform to determine the correct built-in tools and settings available.

questions.title: Do you want to limit total daily screen time or specific apps?
questions.description: Clarify whether the limit applies to overall device usage or is targeted at particular applications.

questions.title: How many hours or minutes per day is your target limit?
questions.description: Establish the specific time threshold the user wants to enforce each day.

questions.title: Which specific apps or categories are you most trying to restrict?
questions.description: Identify the apps or app categories such as social media, games, or entertainment that are the primary concern.

questions.title: Is this limit for yourself or for another person, like a child?
questions.description: Determine whether this is personal self-control or parental controls for another user on the device.

questions.title: Do you want a hard block or just a usage reminder notification?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants the device to fully lock the app after the limit or simply send an alert.

questions.title: Should the limit apply at all times or only during certain hours?
questions.description: Determine if restrictions should be time-of-day specific, such as during work hours, bedtime, or all day.
